description: Federal lawsuits in the RECAP docket index (CourtListener, Free Law Project) that name a vehicle's manufacturer as a party and mention the model and a vehicle system — product-liability, warranty, lemon-law and class cases, newest first, with court, filing date, docket number, nature of suit and a link to each docket. Asked nightly by WhichTrim's build and cached, so the answer is as the index stood on the date given. A docket's presence says nothing about merits or outcome; state-court cases are not indexed.

make.description: The make, e.g. hyundai, ford, chevrolet.

model.description: The model, e.g. sonata, f-150, silverado.

system.description: Optional vehicle system slug to narrow to: engine, power-train, air-bags, electrical-system, steering, service-brakes, fuel-system, forward-collision-avoidance, suspension, structure. Without it, every system on file is answered.

name: federal_cases
